paragraphs: Library Market describes itself as a small strategic design agency providing branding, marketing, and technology solutions for libraries and their communities. The company states that it focuses exclusively on libraries and that this gives it an advantage over outside firms.

One product is an event management and room reservation software suite called LibraryCalendar. That suite gives library staff a management interface and library patrons a separate experience. A second page lists marketing and branding services alongside an integrated calendar for events, registrations, and room reservations.

The company states that libraries are more successful when they can engage their users through quality technology and branding. The homepage also states that Library Market, LibraryIQ, and OrangeBoy now operate as one organization.

quote.text: Our mission is to help libraries connect to their communities by offering superior marketing and technology products.
